title: </sub>  Pin precision evidence to the immutable model version
text:
</sub>  Pin precision evidence to the immutable model version

When the provider updates a mutable model alias between the real-PR cohort and the later precision run, this criterion still admits the precision evidence because it requires only the same “model identity”; Ronda currently derives that identity from the configured `modelName` (`src/config/load-config.ts:89-90`), and AC8 explicitly recognizes that this may be a mutable alias. The latest immutable-version fix therefore closes the matched-control path but leaves the precision pairing from the earlier model-binding finding vulnerable to the same drift, allowing false-positive behavior from a different underlying model to validate the recall claim. Require the precision evidence and claimed heads to share the same immutable model version, or a precommitted window that guarantees version stability.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/7daafdead1ff8a153636d4ee357dba84011c2d75/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed in 1de209c. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
